title: Model magic item consumables and single-use payloads (M1)
description: Implement family M1 from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4: all 31 items whose §2 rows carry tag M1 (exact membership = grep the artifact table): 17 potions, 3 oils, 3 dusts, restorative-ointment, philter-of-love, bead-of-force, elemental-gem, feather-token, marvelous-pigments, sovereign-glue, universal-solvent, spell-scroll. Shape: consumption event (dose/pinch/bead counts incl. dice-determined found-quantities) + typed effect payload reusing the 18.7.7.2 shapes + duration. Flagship needing design first: spell-scroll (class-list gate, higher-level check DC 10+level with loss-on-failure, scroll DC/attack by level table, copy procedure). Validation: committed-pack depth assertions on the exact membership; schema validation; readiness must not count an item green while any clause is unmodeled. Recommended agent: Codex GPT-5.5 rollout; Opus 4.8 for the spell-scroll procedure design. potion-of-heroism temp-HP payload must integrate with the F6 temp-HP owner (see PR #406 execution-boundary artifact), not invent its own.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Consumables should use the same clause-level split: source-grounded consumption/effect payloads in pack data, with dice/HP/temp-HP/conditions/action/slot hooks bound to shared owners. Spell-scroll irregular procedure design may be a curated semantic spec if it satisfies source locator, schema, parity, and drift-failure checks.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
